newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIUPANK TO OPEN OFFICE IN LITHUANIA.
newsitem.headline: HOIUPANK TO OPEN OFFICE IN LITHUANIA.

text.p: Estonia's second largest bank, Hoiupank, plans to open an office in Lithuania early next year, Hoiupank said on Tuesday.
"We plan to open a representative office in Lithuania in January or February next year," Kristi Liiva, head of the bank's press office, told Reuters.
"The office will give us a foot in the door to watch the market's development," she added.
"It is only one small step of our larger strategy to expand into neighbouring countries," she added.
Hoiupank earlier said it was considering buying a Lithuanian bank, but this idea was dropped after several months of negotiations.
